text:
isha: 03:14 — FYI nightly perf dashboard flagged a 35–50ms p99 jump on 'hotpath-v2' across dedicated pool.
perf-bot: [ALERT] metric=p99_latency service=runtime-hotpath baseline=18ms current=60ms change=+42ms link=https://dash/internal/reports/2398765432
tom: seeing the same in CI e2e-perf (job 4821). spike lines up with an evening merge by eve.
ana: starting bisect across canary->master window 22:30-02:00
ana: (typo) ana: starting bisect across canary->master window 22:30-02:00
jason: kernel-selector logs show more frequent handoffs at ~03:12; looks like selector epsilon changed to favor fallback kernels
isha: dropping raw trace snippet for quick context:
```json
{"ts":1610004592,"event":"kernel_switch","from":"fast-kernel","to":"fallback-kernel","lat_ms":12}
{"ts":1610004593,"event":"kv_eviction","key":"k:123","size":8192}
```
tom: interesting — I recall PR #8552 touched opportunistic batching timing. could be related.
nana: PR 8552 (author: @eve) did adjust batching idle-window and prefetch hints. bisect on that commit next.
perf-bot: [CI] e2e-perf job 4821: p99=62ms (threshold 50ms) — failing consistently on the canary group
jason: profiler flamegraph snapshot (abridged):
```text
hotpath_v2: 40%
 kernel_selector: 18%
 batch_coordinator: 12%
 kv_cache: 9%
```
isha: KV metrics look noisy — eviction rate x3 at the same time window, miss rate up. smaller batches can increase working set churn.
nana: bisect points at commit 8552 — creating revert candidate.
tom: can we patch kernel selector to prefer the low-latency kernel for short sequences as a temporary mitigation?
jason: created revert PR: revert(eve/8552). kicking a canary deploy now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-hotpath@revert-8552 -> pool=dedicated-1 (instances: 1/5 -> 5/5)
isha: canary graphs look promising — p99 trending back to baseline within ~7m of revert.
perf-bot: [RESOLVED] alert closed — p99 back to ~22ms (observed 22ms)
nana: rolling revert to prod, opening follow-up ticket to rework batching thresholds and add perf unit tests.
tom: I will file the perf-regression postmortem and attach the bisect logs, assigning remediation to @eve to lead the revised patch.
jason: note: add per-token KV cache reuse/miss instrumentation and a CI e2e perf guard for kernel handoffs.
isha: great triage — keep an eye on ingress pattern shifts overnight :thumbsup:
